Oyster Therapeutics · brandmark brainstorm, round twenty

One colour, for overlays

Round nineteen’s 05, Model with the traced ring, pared back to one colour. No fills, shading or tints: each version is drawn in a single colour on a clear ground, so it can sit in white over a dark image or in black over a light one, as a corner bug, a watermark or a centred stamp. Each is shown in both palettes, at small sizes, with the logotype, and over four stand-in images. Clasped only. Structures: PDB 5T35, Gadd et al., Nat. Chem. Biol. 2017; the degrader is drawn generically.

01

Line

The two outlines and the split pearl, nothing else.

The lightest; sits quietly over an image.

Contour lines

The outlines with the contour rings and the traced ring in BRD4 as hairlines, like a topographic map.

Keeps the 3D-model story; best at larger sizes.

03

Solid

Both proteins as solid shapes, the traced ring cut out of BRD4, the seam and pearl pocket left clear.

The boldest and most legible at small sizes.
